notes.title: New update 1.5 !!!
notes.content:
Finally we managed to fix the bug that causes the game could not be started. This error was caused by an incompatibility in the new version of GameMaker and API Steam.

To get everything back to work correctly it may be necessary to delete the local content and reinstall the game.

In addition to these important corrections, we have fixed some of the most reported bugs.

notes.title: The great update! Now you can select difficulty!
notes.content:
With the new patch [b]1.45[/b] you can change the difficulty of the game. Now you can pass the game on easy mode and once you've learned to handle it well you will not have problems in the  hardcore mode!

In easy mode, you will play with a slower owys so it will be easier to adapt to their control. In addition you will have 5 extra lives at the begining. 

To change the difficulty presss X in the keyboard or gamepad in the select world screen.


Other changes:
[olist]
    [*]Now you can change the brightness at the begining of the game with the gamepad.
    [*]Other corrections.
[/olist]
